breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the gravity vector. The inconsistency states that the gravity vector should be along the -Y axis to match the problem setup (height oriented along Y). The ground truth corrects this to `(0 -9.81 0)`. However, the generated specification repeated the original incorrect instruction, setting the gravity vector to `(0 0 -9.81)`, which is along the -Z axis.
